# Official preset (5 / win by 2 / max 8): a full game with sensor goals.
expect phase idle
start official
expect phase playing
expect score 0:0
expect last game_started

wait 12s
sensor home_goal              # ball in the home net: a point for away
expect score 0:1
expect last goal side=away
expect next_ball home         # conceding side gets the ball (default)

sensor away_goal
sensor away_goal
sensor away_goal
sensor away_goal
expect score 4:1
sensor home_goal
sensor home_goal
sensor home_goal
expect score 4:4
sensor away_goal
expect score 5:4              # 5:4 is not enough, win by 2
expect phase playing
sensor away_goal
expect score 6:4
expect winner home reason=score
expect phase finished
expect last finished side=home

# During the hold a goal only returns the ball.
sensor away_goal
expect score 6:4
wait 9s
expect phase finished
wait 1s
expect phase idle
expect score 6:4              # the last game stays visible
sensor home_goal              # idle: ignored
expect games 1
expect status 1 finished
